Name: Vanilla Styled Electric Mill (CP)
Author: Warilized
Description:
[size=3]Have you ever wonder why the mill looks weird in some way or another?
Have you ever though "I should hire a better carpenter to do this job"?

Well, you now can magically replace it with the power of science! Or so they said...
﻿
[/size][center][size=3]-------------------------------[/size][/center][size=3]
[b]About this mod:
[/b]This is a Vanilla Mill texture mod. It replace the Mill to a more good looking modern Vanilla looking mill (?)
[/size][size=3]
[b]This Mod Contains:
[/b]This mod comes with 3 different types of Mills:[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Type 1: Electric Mill with Fan[/size]
[*][size=3]Type 2: Electric mill without Fan[/size]
[*][size=3]Type 3: Taller version of Type 2[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Configurations:[/b]
[list]
[*]Enable Mod: "true/false" - Enables the mod.
[*]Style: "Type #" - Mill Style.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Installation:[/b]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Con﻿tent Patcher[/url]﻿, or else this mod is useless.[/size]
[*][size=3]If this is your first installation, skip this step. Before placing the mod into "Mods" folder, deleting old mod file is recommended to avoid some problems.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip this mod paste it into "Mods" folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]Done[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Uninstallation:[/b]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Delete the mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Done.[/size]
[/list]
